description: "Ancient Legends, Mystic Charms & Superstitions of Ireland" by Lady Wilde is a collection of folklore and mythological tales compiled in the early 20th century. This volume explores a range of captivating stories drawn from Irish oral traditions, delving into the rich tapestry of superstitions, legends, and the enchanting history of the Irish people.
